'''Odis P. Valyn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Major/Legends|major]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] stationed on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] during the [[Galactic War]]. At the time of the [[invasion of Belsavis]] around [[3641 BBY]] he was part of [[Cell Block Command]] in the [[Maximum Security Section]], where he asked a Republic citizen to strike a blow against the [[Esh-kha]] forces in the area.
